# Vendor Info: Marked

- **Project**: [Ultra-fast markdown parser and compiler](https://github.com/markedjs/marked)
- **Version**: 18.0.11
- **License**: MIT
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/marked)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `vendor/updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Select **Marked** from the dropdown menu.
3. Click "Download" and select this local directory (`vendor/marked/`) when prompted.
4. The tool will automatically update this `_VENDOR-INFO.md` file.
5. Update the version number in the root [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md).

**Files maintained by the updater**
* `marked.umd.min.js`
